intro: Serbian culture is known for medieval monasteries, lively brass bands and the inventor Nikola Tesla.

chapters.title: Famous Serbs
text: Nikola Tesla, the inventor of alternating current electricity systems, was born to a Serb family; Belgrade's airport is named after him. Ivo Andrić won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1961 for The Bridge on the Drina.

chapters.title: Music and food
text: The Guča Trumpet Festival is a huge celebration of Balkan brass bands, and the EXIT music festival is held in a fortress in Novi Sad. Ćevapi (grilled meat), ajvar (pepper relish) and burek pastry are favourites, and the kolo circle dance is on UNESCO's list.

keyTerms.meaning: A traditional circle dance of the Balkans.
